title: Pagasa: LPA east of Northern Samar to bring rains on Saturday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The state weather bureau on Friday said the low-pressure area (LPA) off Northern Samar will affect some areas in the country until Saturday, Oct. 10. In its 4 p.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, Quezon, Marinduque, and Romblon may experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms due to the LPA. As of 3 p.m., the weather disturbance was located 520 kilometers (km) east of Catarman, Northern Samar inside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR).
